text:
hector_marcom: Quick ask from marketing: we want a short "sanity snapshot" CSV for the launch press pack showing p50/p95 latencies and cost per 1k tokens for each model variant at seq 128. Also need the tiny methodology blurb and exact run command. Keeping it minimal because press wants a one-page data sheet.

violet_runtime: We can produce that. Which model variants? gpt-small@v1, gpt-small@v1-q4, and gpt-medium@v1?

hector_marcom: Stick to the small variants only. gpt-small@v1 and gpt-small@v1-q4. Warmed definition: 1000 tokens. Use cohort-weighted aggregation. Seed 1337.

ben_ops: Will ensure uploads go to s3://redwood-press-pack/ and set bucket policy to public-read for the press pack files only. CI job perf-press-snapshot scheduled.

ci-bot: perf-press-snapshot scheduled: 2024-08-01T06:00Z 2 runs.

violet_runtime: I'll push a tiny CSV: press_snapshot_seq128.csv with columns model,variant,p50_ms,p95_ms,cost_per_1k_usd,run_ts and a short method.txt. ETA: 8 hours.

hector_marcom: Awesome, tag me when done and paste the run command for the method blurb.

violet_runtime: Run command we'll use:
```
./run_perf.sh --model gpt-small@v1 --variant fp16 --seq 128 --workers 6 --warmup_tokens 1000 --seed 1337 --out s3://redwood-press-pack/run_${RUN_TS}/
```

hector_marcom: thanks! :tada:
